metadata.title: Radiant Portrait with Gold Script Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, warm-toned close-up portrait of a smiling woman with voluminous brown hair, featuring a large, elegant gold monolinear script signature overlaid across the lower third of the frame, accompanied by a small sans-serif subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: The large script acts as a foreground veil over the subject's torso and arms.
Warm skin tones and hair highlights harmonize with the metallic gold lettering.
The subject's diagonal head tilt is balanced by the horizontal flow of the typography.
High-key white background creates a clean, airy contrast for the detailed hair textures.
coreInvariants: Monolinear script with consistent stroke weight
Direct eye contact with a joyful expression

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered and tightly cropped, filling approximately 80% of the frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and smile serve as the primary focal point, anchored by the large gold lettering below.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the face, follows the hair down to the left, then sweeps across the gold script to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white negative space in the upper left corner provides breathing room for the dense hair texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and tans in the subject's hair and skin.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white background and bedding providing high-key luminosity.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold for the primary typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (brightness) throughout with moderate saturation in the skin tones to emphasize a healthy glow.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones, gold, and white

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with elongated ascenders and descenders
letterConstructionRules: Extended horizontal flourishes that cross over the subject
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial capital letter features an exaggerated diagonal cross-stroke
Final character includes a long, sweeping tail that anchors the right side
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large, expressive custom script paired with a tiny, clean geometric sans-serif for modern contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, modern look of the subtitle.
Captures the fluid, uniform stroke of the main lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio portrait of a woman with voluminous brown hair and highlights, smiling warmly, lying on white bedding against a white background. Use warm, golden-hour lighting to emphasize skin glow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, monolinear gold script signature across the lower third of the image, ensuring it overlaps the subject. Below it, add a small, wide-tracked uppercase sans-serif subtitle in a matching gold tone.

verificationChecks: Is the script monolinear without calligraphic variation?
Is the lighting warm and high-key?
Does the text overlap the subject without obscuring the face?
Is the subtitle small and widely spaced?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the gold script feels integrated into the composition.
Ensure the skin tones look natural and radiant.
Verify the background is clean white without artifacts.
Confirm the subtitle is legible despite its small size.
recipe.reuseFormula: Warm Portrait + High-Key Background + Monolinear Gold Script Overlay + Geometric Sans Subtitle
